name: NVIDIA Corp
day_summary: NVDA dropped −6.2% to $205.10 in a heavy de-risking session, the worst day of a rough week that pulled the stock well off its $235 record. Puts and shorts paid; dip-buyers who stepped in early got run over. A valuation cool-down, not a fundamental crack.

decision.rationale: Don't catch the knife on a −6% day. The AI demand story is intact, so this is a HOLD — keep core, wait for the selling to exhaust and a base to form before adding.

positioning.notable_flow: Put buying surged through the session as momentum names were sold; vol bid into the close.

what_traders_are_doing: Broad de-risking in high-multiple tech; NVDA was a source of liquidity on the down day even though the data-center demand story was unchanged.

news.label: NVDA fell 6.2% ($218.66 → $205.10) in a momentum-tech selloff, extending a pullback from the May 14 record of $235.47

outlook.short_term: Defensive; watch whether $200 holds on a retest.
outlook.long_term: Unchanged and bullish — a valuation reset, not a demand crack.

bull_case: Selloff is multiple-driven; record revenue and the AI order book are intact.
Still far above the 52-week low; long-term uptrend unbroken.
bear_case: ~31x forward is the wrong multiple to own into a momentum unwind.
Most-owned AI name — crowded long, profit-taking can cascade.
